title: N22 canonical source-backed Paper screen contract v1

PaperHistoryRecords.description: Retained account-equity history, not a bounded snapshot page. The existing producer returns exact sparse rows or per-series bucket extrema (target2000 is not a hard output ceiling). Inspect history_windows for coverage/downsampling; do not assert a fabricated row ceiling or truncate history to the snapshot page size. This DTO does not qualify projection cardinality/response-byte budgets.

VenueCalendar.description: FE-070. Present only on the VN market workbench variant. Every member is a Fact: the Portal holds no trading-calendar source of truth, so each is NOT_PUBLISHED (N28_VENUE_CALENDAR_NOT_ACTIVE) until the market-data-layer session calendar is wired. is_open is the SOURCE's own statement at as_of; a client never infers PAUSED or AGING from window arithmetic.

VenueBreak.description: The interval between two consecutive published windows (the lunch break). Arithmetic on published windows only.

VenueWindow.description: A named window in the venue's local time. OPENING_AUCTION / CLOSING_AUCTION (ATO / ATC) only when the source names them; a generic session is TRADING_SESSION. Window kinds describe the market calendar, not which order types the Portal can route.

StageFacts.description: FE-067. Additive on the Paper workbench (`data.stage_facts`) and on the Sandbox, Canary and Live Full bodies (top level `stage_facts`). The pre-existing pinned-null `runtime_state` members are unchanged.

StageSessionsFact.description: Newest first. `ended` null while the session has no completion time. A row the reader cannot type is counted in omitted_count, never listed. `state` is the source's own word or null.

unknown_order_count.description: Open findings the reviewed finding-type table classes as UNKNOWN_ORDER. Exact 0 only when no finding is open; NOT_PUBLISHED (FINDING_TYPE_VOCABULARY_NOT_CLASSIFIED) while any open finding is unclassified.

StageFactVerdict.description: NO_OPEN_FINDINGS is a statement about the findings relation, not a reconciliation run: it is never published from a partial window or when any finding status is unreadable.

StageFactRuntimeState.description: Closed vocabulary. Published only when the SOURCE deployment row carries the word; never derived from `active`, a session, readiness or freshness. A source word outside the vocabulary is refused (reason RUNTIME_STATE_WORD_NOT_IN_CLOSED_VOCABULARY), not echoed.

StageReasonCode.description: Reviewed machine code saying why a fact is not published. Never free text, never a source message.

DeploymentDisplayName.description: FE-066: a display name or null (see the sibling reason code). No control or bidirectional-format characters; no leading or trailing whitespace.

AlphaIdentityReason.description: FE-066: why alpha_id or alpha_name is null. NOT_QUALIFIED = this read path has no qualified deployment-to-alpha publication; a strategy id is never promoted to an alpha id.

DeploymentIdentityRules.description: FE-066: the five identity keys travel together; a name is present iff its reason is null; alpha_name implies alpha_id.

DeploymentRecord.description: FE-066: the Paper profile deployment block: the source row plus the Alpha-Portfolio identity keys.

PositionsBySide.description: S3-U4 / FE-051: Long, Short and Gross by side for the deployment's open positions: exact quantity per instrument (gross = long + short, magnitudes), no total across instruments. Notional by side is never derived: the position page publishes no currency or mark lineage (E5), so notional is a typed unavailable, not a number.
